name.en-US: foxcache — your AI chats in your browser

summary.en-US: Copy your own conversations, projects, memories and custom instructions from ChatGPT, Claude, Le Chat, DeepSeek, Gemini and NotebookLM into your browser. Read-only, and nothing leaves your computer.

description.en-US:
foxcache copies your own data from the AI chat sites you are signed in to, into this browser: conversations, projects (name, instructions and file names), saved memories, and custom instructions or response style.

**Who it is for:** people who use several AI chat sites and want one copy of their own history and context that they keep, search and move.

**What it does**

- In the settings page you allow each site one at a time: ChatGPT, Claude, Le Chat (Mistral), DeepSeek, Gemini and NotebookLM.
- Open the site and sign in as you always do, then click Capture in the toolbar popup. foxcache reads your data with the session the tab already has. It never sees your password and never reads a cookie.
- It only reads. Every request it makes is a read from a fixed list, to the site's own address: a GET, or for Gemini and NotebookLM a POST that only reads. They go one at a time with a pause between them. It never sends, edits or deletes anything on the site.
- Stop ends a capture; Resume goes on from where it stopped. A second capture fetches only what changed.
- The archive page lets you browse and search everything by site and kind, and export it as one archive file, as Markdown files, or as a memory list.
- Delete all removes everything foxcache keeps.

**What leaves your computer:** nothing. foxcache has no server and no analytics. The only network requests are the reads from the AI site you are signed in to, from your own tab. It answers one other add-on, foxscope (foxscope@pooriaarab), which runs in this browser and asks you before it shares your memories, preferences or project names. It never shares conversations. Every other add-on gets no answer.

**Permissions**

- Access to chatgpt.com, claude.ai, chat.mistral.ai, chat.deepseek.com, gemini.google.com and notebook.google.com: optional, and asked for one site at a time when you allow it in the settings. foxcache reads a site only when you click Capture.
- Scripting: run the capture inside the site's tab, so it uses the session you already have.
- Unlimited storage: a large chat history must not hit the browser's storage quota.

The source code is MIT licensed.

version.approval_notes: The uploaded source.zip is the git tree of this release. To build: install Node 24 and pnpm 11 (corepack enable), run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm build:ext`. The output is dist-ext/. esbuild bundles extension/*.js with src/; the other files are copied unmodified. To try it without an AI account: there is no demo mode. With an account: open the add-on preferences, allow chatgpt.com (or claude.ai), open that site and sign in, then click Capture in the toolbar popup and open the archive. Every request goes through src/http.ts, which has GET on the site's own origin and nothing else. onMessageExternal answers only the sender foxscope@pooriaarab.
